$comment: Spec R6/D4: coverage is judged against the fields that existed when the game was played, not against a single uniform field list. Otherwise a 2015 game is `partial` because void grubs were not invented yet, and a marker that fires on every row cannot catch the one row it exists for. An era is a contiguous window; a field that did not exist inside the window is ineligible and is excluded from the coverage computation. Eras are contiguous on purpose, so a field that was temporarily removed (the Chemtech Drake) is expressed by an era that omits it, with no extra mechanism. `cites` records where the boundary comes from: six are wiki patch pages for the version named, and one is Riot's own announcement, because that withdrawal was a mid-patch disable rather than a patch. Nothing here is inferred from this dataset: a table derived from the corpus would make the one assertion worth making true by construction.

team-stats.cites: The dataset's declared era floor (spec objective): 2011. Before the Rift Herald, a team-stat row is kills, gold, towers, inhibitors, barons and a plain dragon count.
V5.22, released 2015-11-11 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V5.22): the Rift Herald enters the Baron pit.
V6.1, released 2016-01-14 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V6.1): drakes become elemental (Cloud, Infernal, Mountain, Ocean) and the Elder Dragon appears.

V11.23 went live on 2021-11-17 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V11.23; Riot's patch notes are dated 2021-11-16 and the wiki's Season 2022 page dates the preseason start to 2021-11-17): the Hextech and Chemtech Drakes join the elemental set.

Riot announced the disable on 2022-01-24 and it took effect on 2022-01-25 ('Disabling the Chemtech Drake', leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/disabling-the-chemtech-drake/); patch 12.2 had shipped on 2022-01-20, so this was a mid-patch disable rather than a patch boundary, which is why no patch page carries it.
V12.22, released 2022-11-16 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V12.22): the Chemtech Drake returns in a reworked form.
V14.1, released 2024-01-10 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V14.1): Voidgrubs spawn in the top-side jungle.
V25.S1.1, released 2025-01-09 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V25.S1.1): Atakhan joins the epic monsters.
